privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This policy explains how Dakermanji Solutions collects, uses, shares, and protects personal information when you visit the website or use its accounts, chat, social, contact, and weather features.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible
paragraphs: Dakermanji Solutions is the public operating name of Behnam Dakermanji, based in Laval, Québec, Canada. Behnam Dakermanji is responsible for protecting personal information and acts as the Privacy Officer.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect only the information reasonably needed to operate, secure, and improve the services you choose to use.
items: Account and profile information, including your email address, username, chosen avatar, country, language, and theme preference.

Authentication information, including a securely hashed password or an account identifier supplied by Google, GitHub, or Discord when you use those sign-in methods. We do not receive your third-party password.
Content and activity you provide, including contact messages, chat messages, notes, reactions, reports, room activity, friendships, blocks, invitations, and notifications.
Security and technical information, including session identifiers, IP address, browser or device user-agent, sign-in events, timestamps, and error diagnostics.
Weather information you request, including a searched place or coordinates supplied by your browser when you choose current location.

sections.title: 3. Why we use information
items: Create and manage accounts, authenticate users, and recover or delete accounts.
Provide profiles, social connections, private notes, chat rooms, messages, moderation, notifications, contact, and weather features.
Remember language and appearance preferences.
Prevent abuse, investigate security events, enforce service rules, and maintain reliability.
Respond to questions, privacy requests, and legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: We currently use essential or preference technologies only. We do not use advertising cookies or audience analytics cookies.
items: The ds.sid cookie keeps your session secure and, when you sign in, keeps you authenticated. It normally expires after one day and is renewed while you remain active.
Language and theme preferences remember how you want the website displayed.
Temporary security values support CSRF protection and third-party sign-in flows.

sections.title: 5. Service providers and disclosures
paragraphs: We do not sell personal information. Information is disclosed only when needed to provide a requested feature, protect the service, comply with law, or operate through a service provider. Depending on the feature, information may be processed outside Québec or Canada.
items: Google, GitHub, or Discord processes information when you choose its sign-in service.
OpenWeather and Open-Meteo receive a place or coordinates needed to return requested weather information.
Sentry may receive error diagnostics and related request or device information for security and reliability monitoring.
Web Hosting Canada (WHC) hosts the website and may process information stored or transmitted through its infrastructure, including server logs, account data, database content, and backups.
Email and content-delivery providers process information needed to deliver and operate the service.
Authorities or other parties may receive information when disclosure is required or permitted by law, or necessary to protect rights, safety, and service integrity.

sections.title: 6. What other users can see
paragraphs: Your username, avatar, and selected country may be visible to other signed-in users where social and chat features require them. Messages and room activity are visible to their intended participants and, where necessary, authorized room moderators. Private notes are intended to be visible only to you. Do not submit information you do not want the relevant participants to see.

sections.title: 7. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Account information and user content are generally kept while your account is active. You can request account deletion from your profile. Deletion removes the account and associated records where the service is designed to do so. Limited records may be retained when reasonably necessary for security, fraud prevention, backup integrity, dispute resolution, or legal compliance, and are then deleted or de-identified when no longer required.
Session cookies normally expire after one day. Verification, recovery, invitation, and similar temporary records expire according to their operational security periods.

sections.title: 8. Security
paragraphs: We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards appropriate to the information involved, including password hashing, access controls, secure session settings, CSRF protection, security headers, validation, and activity monitoring. No internet service can guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 9. Children and minimum age
paragraphs: People of all ages may view the public portfolio pages. You must be at least 14 years old to create an account or use features that collect personal information. We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from a child under 14 without consent from a parent or legal guardian. If you believe this has occurred, contact the Privacy Officer so the information can be reviewed and removed as appropriate.

sections.title: 10. Your privacy rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may ask whether we hold personal information about you, request access or correction, withdraw consent where applicable, ask questions, or make a complaint. You may also change available profile preferences or request account deletion through the website. We may need to verify your identity before completing a request.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when the service or legal requirements change. The updated date will be revised, and notice of material changes will be provided through an appropriate and reasonably visible method.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: These terms govern access to Dakermanji Solutions and its account, social, chat, contact, and weather features. By creating an account or using an interactive feature, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: 1. Service operator
paragraphs: Dakermanji Solutions is the public operating name of Behnam Dakermanji, based in Laval, Québec, Canada. References to “Dakermanji Solutions,” “we,” “us,” or “our” mean Behnam Dakermanji operating under that name.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility and acceptance
paragraphs: People of all ages may browse the public portfolio. You must be at least 14 years old to create an account or use interactive features that collect personal information. If the law where you live requires a higher age to consent to these terms, a parent or legal guardian must consent on your behalf.
You accept these terms when you create an account or use an interactive feature. If you do not accept them, do not create an account or use those features.

sections.title: 3. Accounts and security
items: Provide accurate information and keep it reasonably current.
Protect your password and third-party sign-in accounts, and do not share access to your account.
Notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access or another security issue.
You are responsible for activity performed through your account to the extent permitted by law.
Do not impersonate another person, create deceptive accounts, or attempt to bypass an account restriction.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
paragraphs: Use the service lawfully and respectfully. You must not:
items: Harass, threaten, exploit, defraud, stalk, or harm another person.
Post unlawful, hateful, sexually exploitative, privacy-invasive, or otherwise seriously abusive material.
Share content that infringes intellectual property, privacy, publicity, confidentiality, or other rights.
Send spam, malware, deceptive links, or unauthorized commercial promotions.
Probe, disrupt, overload, scrape, reverse engineer, or bypass security, access controls, rate limits, or moderation systems, except where applicable law expressly permits the activity.
Collect information about other users without authorization or use the service for unlawful surveillance.
Use automated access unless we have given prior written permission.

sections.title: 5. Your content
paragraphs: You retain ownership of content you submit. You grant us a limited, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, store, reproduce, transmit, display, and technically modify that content only as reasonably necessary to operate, secure, moderate, and provide the service. This licence ends when the content is deleted from active systems, subject to reasonable backup, security, and legal retention.
You represent that you have the rights needed to submit your content and grant this licence. You remain responsible for your content and for deciding what to share with other users.

sections.title: 6. Moderation and enforcement
paragraphs: We may investigate reports and use automated or human moderation measures. Where reasonably necessary, we may hide or remove content, limit features, remove users from rooms, suspend or terminate accounts, preserve relevant evidence, or report conduct to appropriate authorities. Room owners and authorized moderators may also manage participation and content within their rooms.
We aim to apply these measures reasonably, but we are not required to monitor every communication and cannot guarantee that all objectionable content will be identified immediately.

sections.title: 7. Third-party services
paragraphs: The service may rely on or link to third-party services, including sign-in, weather, hosting, email, monitoring, and content-delivery providers. Their own terms and policies may apply to your dealings with them. We are not responsible for third-party services beyond responsibilities that applicable law does not allow us to exclude.

sections.title: 8. Availability and changes
paragraphs: The service is currently provided without a fee. We may maintain, update, add, remove, suspend, or discontinue features. We do not promise uninterrupted, error-free, or permanently available service. When reasonably possible, we will give appropriate notice of material changes that significantly affect users.

sections.title: 9. Account termination
paragraphs: You may stop using the service and request account deletion through your profile. We may restrict, suspend, or terminate access when we reasonably believe these terms were violated, the account creates risk or harm, or action is required by law. Where appropriate and legally permitted, we may provide notice or an opportunity to correct the issue.
Terms that by their nature should survive termination—including provisions concerning ownership, retained records, disclaimers, liability, and disputes—continue to apply.

sections.title: 10. Disclaimers
paragraphs: The service, portfolio material, weather information, and user content are provided for general informational and demonstration purposes. Weather information may be delayed or inaccurate and must not be relied on for emergencies, safety-critical decisions, or professional advice.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, the service is provided “as is” and “as available,” without warranties beyond those that cannot legally be excluded.

sections.title: 11. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Dakermanji Solutions is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for loss of data, opportunity, reputation, or profits arising from use of or inability to use the service. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability, warranties, remedies, or consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

sections.title: 12. Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of Québec and the federal laws of Canada applicable there, without depriving you of mandatory protections available under the law where you live. Before starting formal proceedings, please contact us so we can try to resolve the concern informally. Any dispute may be brought before a court that has jurisdiction under applicable law.

sections.title: 13. Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update these terms when the service or legal requirements change. The updated date will be revised and material changes will be communicated through an appropriate and reasonably visible method. Continued use after revised terms take effect constitutes acceptance only to the extent permitted by law.
